profile.name: Specim Aisa Kestrel 10 高光谱相机
profile.description: 这是一款高光谱成像相机，用于采集样品在多个波段上的图像数据，常用于材料表征、样品筛查、反射/辐射成像等实验。实验中通常需要根据光照条件和采集速度调节帧率、积分时间、快门状态，并可启用非均匀性校正以改善成像质量。
profile.description_en: This is a hyperspectral imaging camera used to acquire image data across multiple spectral bands. It is commonly used in laboratory work such as material characterization, sample screening, and reflectance or radiance imaging. In use, the frame rate, integration time, and shutter state are adjusted to match illumination and acquisition conditions, and non-uniformity correction may be enabled to improve image quality.
